description: Hourly time series and summary statistics (min, max, average, trend) for Kaspa on-chain metrics (hashrate, difficulty, tx-count, active-addresses) for a given UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD). Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_kaspa_hashrate when you need Kaspa network hashrate current state, all-time peak; crypto_kaspa_supply when you need Kaspa coin supply metrics: circulating supply, max supply. Price: $0.005 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

date.description: UTC date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to previous UTC day).

name: crypto_kaspa_metrics_history
